This lets Flack see Slack messages. Flack sends nothing over the internet unless you sign in to Slack, and then it talks only to Slack.

Allow restricted settings

Android protects this setting for apps installed outside Google Play.

1. Tap Open App info below.
2. Tap the menu (three dots) in the top corner.
3. Tap Allow restricted settings and confirm.
4. Come back and turn on notification access.

Samsung puts apps to sleep. Choose \"Allow\" or \"Unrestricted\" for Flack so messages keep coming while you drive.

Allow Flack in Android Auto

Show me how
Check Android Auto settings
You checked Unknown sources for this version. If Flack disappears from the car, check Unknown sources and Customize launcher again.
Your Android Auto version changed. Check that Unknown sources is on and Flack is selected under Customize launcher.
Check Android Auto settings

1. Open phone Settings and search for Android Auto. If App info opens, tap Configure in Android Auto.
2. Open the three-dot menu and tap Developer settings. If it is missing, scroll to Version, tap to expand it, then tap the expanded version information 10 times and tap OK. Return to Developer settings.
3. Check that Unknown sources is on.
4. Go back and tap Customize launcher. If Flack is listed, make sure it is selected. Disconnect and reconnect Android Auto to see launcher changes.

If Android Auto or Gemini offers a setting to send replies automatically, turn it off, so you hear every reply before it is sent.
